about_blocks.text: Clinique Nouveau Départ offers a wide range of addiction treatment services for individuals struggling with various types of addictions. These services target both substance and behavioral addictions that include but are not limited to alcohol and drug addictions, gambling, internet and sex addictions, among others. The clinic provides detox, inpatient, outpatient, specialized trauma, and specialized return from relapse programs, each designed to meet specific needs of the clients. The specialized trauma program caters to members of the Canadian armed forces and first responders who experience trauma and stress-related disorders like PTSD. Nursing and medical services are available 24/7 with a maximum of eight people in the program, ensuring individualized attention. The return from relapse program focuses on helping clients overcome challenges they faced in their previous rehabilitation attempts. They learn skills such as emotion regulation, distress tolerance, and mindfulness.

about_blocks.text: With the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, Clinique Nouveau Départ has adapted its services to meet the needs of clients seeking addiction treatment. They now offer online telehealth treatment to ensure the continuity of care while keeping clients and staff safe from the virus. This virtual service offers the same quality of personalized attention provided in-person, including assessments, therapy sessions, and individualized treatment plans. The telehealth program benefits include easy and flexible scheduling, convenience, increased accessibility, and affordability.

about_blocks.text: Located in downtown Montreal, Clinique Nouveau Départ has been providing addiction recovery services for over 30 years. Its mission is to provide hope, reunite families, and improve communities through comprehensive and compassionate care. The clinic has a multidisciplinary team consisting of doctors, psychiatrists, psychologists, nurses, psychotherapists, psychometricians, social workers, and coaches. They offer services in both English and French to ensure all clients can access the services they need. Clinique Nouveau Départ has adequate accommodation facilities, including an executive room, private, semi-private, and triple bedroom options. They also have an entertainment and reading room, fitness room, and laundry room, all aimed at making clients feel comfortable and supported during their recovery journey.

about_blocks.text: Clinique Nouveau Départ – EHN Canada is a reputable addiction rehab center located in Montreal, Quebec. With over three decades of experience in providing specialized services for individuals struggling with addiction and comorbid mental health issues, this private clinic is committed to meeting the unique needs of each patient they serve. Their holistic approach to treatment includes medical, therapeutic, biopsychosocial, and human care.

about_blocks.text: Their medical care ensures that every patient receives proper diagnosis, assessment, and adequate treatment. Their therapeutic care involves personalized treatment plans that consider factors such as severity of the pathology, social and professional environment, and available support networks. The biopsychosocial component integrates medical, psychiatric, psychological, pharmacological, and therapeutic aspects to provide comprehensive care for the patient. Moreover, the human care approach involves families at every stage of recovery, ensuring that patients receive support not just from medical professionals but also from loved ones.
